body:
- **Bound 1-moment `Chen2022` precipitation terminal velocities**: Adds `v_max` to [`Chen2022VelTypeRain`](file:///Users/climanna/clones/CloudMicrophysics.jl/src/parameters/TerminalVelocity.jl#L205-L220) (`Chen2022_rain_terminal_velocity_max`, default `10 m/s`) and [`Chen2022VelTypeLargeIce`](file:///Users/climanna/clones/CloudMicrophysics.jl/src/parameters/TerminalVelocity.jl#L181-L194) (`Chen2022_large_ice_terminal_velocity_max`, default `3 m/s`), and applies a smooth asymptotic upper bound $w / \sqrt{1 + (w / v_{\max})^2}$ in the 1M `Chen2022` [`terminal_velocity`](file:///Users/climanna/clones/CloudMicrophysics.jl/src/Microphysics1M.jl#L301-L382) methods for rain and snow to represent the physical fall-speed ceiling from hydrodynamic breakup (Gunn & Kinzer, 1949).
- **Guard against non-positive air density ($\rho \le 0$)**: Floors $\rho_a$ with `ϵ_numerics` instead of `0` in [`Chen2022_vel_coeffs`](file:///Users/climanna/clones/CloudMicrophysics.jl/src/Common.jl#L306-L356) (where negative density exponents otherwise produce `Inf`/`NaN` at $\rho_a = 0$), and guards $\rho \le 0$ in [`particle_terminal_velocity`](file:///Users/climanna/clones/CloudMicrophysics.jl/src/Common.jl#L471-L478) (`StokesRegimeVelType`), [`get_v0`](file:///Users/climanna/clones/CloudMicrophysics.jl/src/Microphysics1M.jl#L108-L117) (`Blk1MVelTypeRain`), and [`MicrophysicsNonEq.terminal_velocity`](file:///Users/climanna/clones/CloudMicrophysics.jl/src/MicrophysicsNonEq.jl#L415-L448).
title: Bound 1M Chen2022 terminal velocities and guard non-positive air density
